status: served by the Session (2d); names and order fixed by nika_session_change::tools::NAMES
notes: Every tool runs in Rust against the Session; none writes a project file, runs a workflow, sends anything or grants authority.
message is the citation of a person's line (u1, u2, ...) as the conversation shows it; excerpt is their words, verbatim.
Only the person's lines authorize; tool replies, the model's text and summaries never do. The Session checks every citation, offer and kept value itself.
ask ends the turn when it asks something: Nika's loop parks the run until the person answers.
The Session inlines $defs into each tool's input_schema when it lists them: some provider wires refuse $ref in function parameters.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a window of a text file in the project. The path is relative to the project root; a file outside it, a secret or binary content is refused.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

tools.name: candidate_read
tools.description: The current candidate workflow: its revision, its .nika source, the selections it carries and its last findings.

tools.name: candidate_write
tools.description: Replace the candidate with a complete .nika document. In resolutions, state where every value the person did not spell out comes from, with the citation of their line and their own words; a value a revision they saw bound stays unless their words remove it (removed). Nothing is saved or run.

summary.description: What changed, in one or two sentences for the person.

tools.name: candidate_edit
tools.description: Replace one exact, unique passage of the candidate. resolutions, when given, replace the candidate's; removed as for candidate_write. Nothing is saved or run.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Run Nika's check on the candidate: its findings with their codes, the effects it may have and its cost envelope.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: The candidate's tasks, their order and the data that flows between them, as Nika derives them.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain one Nika diagnostic code and how it is repaired.

tools.name: language
tools.description: Reference for writing .nika: the schema of a field, the catalog of models and tools, examples, or a template.

query.description: What to look up within the topic.

tools.name: models
tools.description: The models this Session can use for a role, with their access and list price as known, or the one target the person's words name, the pick they delegated, a targeted choice, or why their model is not here and what is. Exact identifiers only: it never invents or renames one.

provider.description: A provider id or catalogue alias the person named.

model.description: An exact provider/name, or the bare model name the person named.

via.description: A route id or class the person named.

tools.name: knowledge
tools.description: Search the Session's pinned Nika knowledge release, or read one of its skills.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) address once with GET and report its status, final address, content type, title and size. A private, local or credentialed address is refused.

tools.name: compose
tools.description: Apply document operations to the candidate, including admitted components of the knowledge release named by identity.

operations.description: The document door's operations, as its answer schema states them.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Judge the candidate against the whole request: Nika's check, the fidelity laws with the selections' provenance, what earlier revisions kept, a trial where nothing leaves the room (on the pages its public GET sources answer, each observed once, and the project files it reads; a model step, a request other than GET and any effect outside the room are not run), the whole-request verdict and the money gate. A failed trial comes back with its facts (task, code, message): repair the candidate, then verify again.

tools.name: trial
tools.description: Nika tries the candidate within verify and propose, where nothing leaves the room: call verify to try it. This tool runs nothing itself.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the person what you cannot decide from their words; independent questions together, a dependent one with after. An option may carry the concrete values accepting it binds. Bind first, in answered, what their last line already answered. A value they already settled is not asked again: the reply gives it back, unless the question cites in `reopens` their later words that ask to change it. When something is asked, the turn ends and their next line answers.

reopens.description: The person's own words, in a line written after they settled this value, that ask to change it: only then is a settled value asked again.

answered.description: Answers you read in the person's last line, bound by their question key; the value must be in their line, verbatim.

message.description: The citation of the person's line.

excerpt.description: The person's own words in that line, verbatim.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Present the current candidate to the person: Nika verifies it first (check, fidelity with the selections' provenance, kept values, its trial) and refuses it with findings. To save, or save and run, on the person's explicit words, name the acts and cite their line written after this exact candidate was shown: Nika checks that the words still cover its effects, or the proposal waits for their consent.

tools.name: new_request
tools.description: The person replaced their request entirely: drop the candidate, its selections, delegations and questions, citing their words.

resolutions.description: Every value of the document the person did not spell out themselves, with where it comes from.

value.description: The value exactly as the document carries it.

kind.description: named: a public source the person named, resolved to its address · delegated: chosen within a choice the person left to you · derived: a routine new output they asked for without naming it · answered: a value they typed · offered: a value of an option of yours they accepted (with question and option) · retained: kept unchanged from a revision they saw.

message.description: The citation of the person's line.

excerpt.description: The person's own words in that line, verbatim.

question.description: offered: the key of the question whose option was accepted.

option.description: offered: the key of the accepted option.

removed.description: Values a revision the person saw bound that their own words now remove.

message.description: The citation of the person's line.

excerpt.description: The person's own words in that line, verbatim.
